author: Retro Game Corps
description:
The Anbernic RG DS was a severely compromised experience at launch, but thanks to new custom software developments, it's now a decent $100 DS handheld.  In this video I'll show you some software options, my preferred experience, and how to install it yourself.

Buy an Anbernic RG DS:
AliExpress: https://s.click.aliexpress.com/e/_c3rcftQ7
Amazon: https://amzn.to/4rKt1R2
Anbernic direct: https://tinyurl.com/RGDS-RGC

ROCKNIX website: https://rocknix.org/
ROCKNIX nightly builds: https://github.com/ROCKNIX/distribution-nightly/releases/
GammaOS: https://github.com/TheGammaSqueeze/GammaOSNext/releases/
Rufus software: https://rufus.ie/en/
My favorite stylus: https://www.etsy.com/listing/4389860171/small-gaming-stylus-solid-aluminum-retro
use code "RETROSTYLUS" for 30% off
